capabilities: Display an animated character widget in the interface
Drag the widget to make it swing
Toggle auto mode via the widget controller
Add custom widget characters through settings
extras: Supports installation via BRAT; author solicits donations through Alipay and WeChat.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to add a playful desktop-pet style widget to the interface.
summary: Animated character widget that shows a cute Qiuqiu figure you can drag to swing while writing notes.
